newsitem.title: EU: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 12 - THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 21.
newsitem.headline: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 12 - THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 21.

text.p: (All venues Luxembourg, Plateau de Kirchberg)
TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 12

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-84/94 United Kingdom v/ Council: social policy. Annulment of Council directive 93/104/EEC of November 23, 1993, on certain aspects of the organisation of working time. Choice of legal basis. - Judgment C-201/94 Smith and Nephew Pharmaceuticals: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Council directive 65/65/EEC of January 26, 1965, on the co-ordination of laws, regulations and administrative provisions on pharmaceutical specialities. Parallel imports of pharmaceutical products. Conditions for authorising the marketing of a pharmaceutical speciality patented under the same name in another member state. - Opinion C-24/95 Alcan Deutschland: state aid. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of community law in matters of state aid. EC treaty articles 92 and 93, paragraph 3. Obligation to recuperate an illegal subsidy. Difficulties due to national laws protecting the beneficiary of an aid: prescription. Exceptions to the conditio indebiti. - Oral procedure C-70/95 Sodemare: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 52, 58, and 59. National legislation on the exploitation of retirement homes. Welfare benefits restricted to non profit making companies. Public financing of services. - (1100/1000 GMT) Oral procedure C-368/95 Familapress Zeltungsverlag: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty article 30. National law banning the distribution of periodicals offering participation in contests or games (crossword puzzles, etc.) in which it is possible to win prizes of significant value.

FIRST CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-294/95-P Ojha v/ Commission: statutes applying to officials. Appeal against court judgment (first chamber), rendered July 6, 1995, in case T-36/93, Ojha v/ Commission-Annulment of Commission decision of October 20, 1992, prematurely relocating the claimant in the Commission delegation in Dacca to the Commission's Brussels headquarters. Compensation for moral damages.

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure T-390/94 Schroeder v/ Commission: agriculture. Action for damages. Community's non contractual responsibility as it follows from the Commission's adoption of several decisions concerning measures against classic swine fever in Germany.
WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 13

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, SECOND CHAMBER (enlarged) (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure T-260/94 Air Inter v/ Commission: transport. Annulment of article 1 of Commission decision 94/291 of April 27, 1994, on an application procedure for Council regulation 2408/92 (Case VII/AMA/IV/93 - TAT - Paris (Orly) - Marseille and Paris (Orly-Toulouse) - (case dismissed by court following France's withdrawal from case.
THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 14

COURT OF JUSTICE, SECOND CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-305/94 Rotsart de Hertaing: social policy. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 3 of Council directive 77/187/EEC of February 14, 1977, on maintenance of workers' rights in cases of the transfers of companies, operations or parts of operations. Handover from former concessionaire to new concessionaire of all working contracts existing at the date of transfer and concerning staff working in the establishment handed over. - Oral procedure C-67/95 Rank Xerox Manufacturing: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of subpositions 9009 21 00 and 8472 90 90 of combined nomenclature of Common Customs and Excise Tariff - Appliance combining functions of photocopier and fax in combination with a scanner allowing the digital memorisation of a document's date which may then be printed on paper. - Oral procedure joined cases C-225/95, C-226/95, C-227/95 Kapasakalis: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Council directive 89/48/EEC, of December 21, 1988, on a general system for the recognition of higher education diplomas awarded upon completion of professional training of at least three years duration. Breach by a member state of the obligation to transpose the directive. Obligation to compensate for damages caused to individuals.

THIRD CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-273/95 Buratti: agriculture. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 8 and 10 to 12 of Commission regulation 3478/92 of December 1, 1992, laying down detailed rules for the application of the premium system for raw tobacco. Modes for the granting of premiums for leaf tobacco. Date of delivery. Producers co-operative or processing company.

FOURTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure joined cases C-274/95, C-275/95, C-276/95 Ludwig Wuensche: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of sub-positions 1108 13 00 NC and 3505 10 50 NC. Esterised potato flour with an acetyl content of more than 0.5 per cent in weight.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-333/94-P Tetra Pak International v/ Commission: competition. Appeal against court judgment (second chamber) rendered October 6, 1994, in case T-83/91, Tetra Pak International v/ Commission. Refusal to annul Commission decision 92/163 on an application procedure for EC treaty article 86. - Opinion C-97/95 Pascal and Filhos: external relations. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of annex II, article 10, first line and article 25, third line of Council decision 86/283 on the association of overseas countries and territories with the EU. Interpretation of article 201, third line, of Council regulation 2913/92 on the community Common Customs and Excise Tariff. Exports of fish from Greenland to Portugal. Irregular EUR 1 certificates. Collection operation against an importer who presented in good faith EUR 1 documents containing inexact information on the origin of the goods.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-171/95 Tetik: external relations. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 6, paragraph 1 of Council decision 1/80 of the EEC/Turkey association. Worker belonging to the regular work market of a member state. Turkish citizen employed on a boat flying a member state flag and under the legislation of said state as regards working relations, social security arrangements and income tax. Consequences on an eventual right to residence of a voluntary surrender of his job. - Opinion C-344/95 Commission v/ Belgium: free movement of persons. Non respect. Article 48 of EC treaty and Council directive 68/360/EEC of October 15, 1968, on the abolition of restrictions on movement and residence within the EU of workers of member states and their families. Belgian regulations on permits of stay to community citizens. Order to leave the territory for work seekers after three months. Arrangement for registration papers and papers for workers whose stay of residence is under three months. - (1000/0900 GMT) Oral procedure C-351/95 Kadiman: external relations. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 7 of decision 1/80 of the EU/Turkey association. Family members of a Turkish worker regularly employed in a member state. Access to work after three years of normal stay. Determination of duration of normal stay in cases of interruption. - (1045/0945 GMT) Oral procedure C-45/95 Commission v/ Italy: taxation. Non respect. Failure to conform to article 13, point B(c) of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. Exemptions inside a country. Delivery of goods intended exclusively for an exempted activity. Delivery of goods whose acquisition or use are exempt from possible deduction.

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, THIRD CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure T-77/95 SFEI v/ Commission: competition. Annulment of Commission decision of December 30, 1994, rejecting the charge against the French post office and French state, submitted by the claimant under articles 86 and 90 of the EC treaty on the international express courier market.
PROVISIONAL AGENDA FOR TUESDAY-THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 19-21
TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 19

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-42/95 Siemens: company law. - Opinion C-177/95 Ebony Maritime: external relations. - Oral procedure C-189/95 Franzen: free movement of goods.
WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 20

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, SECOND CHAMBER (enlarged)(0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure T-195/95 Guerin Automobiles v/ Commission: competition. - Oral procedure T-38/96 Guerin Automobiles v/ Commission: competition.
THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 21 FIRST CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-138/95-P Campo Ebro Industrial v/ Council: agriculture.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-235/95 AGS Assedic Pas de Calais: social policy. - Oral procedure C-295/95 Farrell: judicial competence convention/execution of decisions. - (1530/1430 GMT) Oral procedure C-147/95 Evrenopoulos: social policy.
COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, FOURTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure T-455/93 Hedley Lomas v/ Commission: agriculture.
